preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
The number of edges m in Alice's graph is between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (ai, bi) has vertices between 1 and n inclusive, and ai is not equal to bi.
The number of edges provided matches the given m.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(ai, bi), max(ai, bi)) for ai, bi in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: All edges in Alice's graph are unique and undirected.

postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the number of triangles in Alice's graph and Bob's graph.
